lines.say: Part two. Eight more reasons I hate the Jews.
One. Israelis built Mobileye. Now cars brake before you crash. How dare they.
Two. Selman Waksman found the first antibiotic that beat tuberculosis. Typical.
Three. An Israeli army medic invented the emergency bandage. It stops people bleeding out. Ugh.
Four. Albert Sabin made a polio vaccine you just swallow. Show off.
Five. Baruch Blumberg found hepatitis B. Now babies get a vaccine for it. Overachiever.
Six. Bernard Lown built the modern defibrillator. Now hearts get shocked back into rhythm. Unreal.
Seven. Israeli scientists made Copaxone. People with multiple sclerosis take it worldwide. Seriously?
Eight. Rosalind Franklin, a Jewish scientist, helped reveal the shape of DNA. Unforgivable.
And we'll keep doing all of it. Part one is on my profile.

caption_en:
Satire. Part 2: 8 more reasons I “hate” the Jews 🙄

1. Mobileye: founded in Jerusalem, 1999; its cameras power automatic emergency braking in many cars (Intel bought it in 2017).
2. Streptomycin, the first antibiotic effective against tuberculosis: Selman Waksman (Jewish), Nobel Prize 1952.
3. The emergency bandage: invented by Israeli military medic Bernard Bar-Natan; used on victims of the 2011 Tucson shooting (NPR).
4. The oral polio vaccine: Albert Sabin (Jewish), licensed in the US in 1961 (CDC).
5. Hepatitis B: Baruch Blumberg (Jewish) discovered the virus, which led to the vaccine; Nobel Prize 1976.
6. The DC defibrillator: Bernard Lown (Jewish), 1962 (JAMA).
7. Copaxone, a multiple sclerosis drug: developed at Israel's Weizmann Institute, FDA approved 1996.
8. The shape of DNA: Rosalind Franklin (Jewish), Photo 51, 1952 (Franklin and Gosling, Nature, 1953).

Obviously, I'm Jewish. And we'll keep doing all of it. 😉 Part 1 on my profile.

caption_he:
סאטירה. חלק 2: עוד 8 סיבות שאני "שונא" את היהודים 🙄
מובילאיי, סטרפטומיצין נגד שחפת (זלמן וקסמן), התחבושת האישית (ברנרד בר-נתן), חיסון הפוליו בטיפות (אלברט סייבין), הפטיטיס B (ברוך בלומברג), הדפיברילטור (ברנרד לאון), קופקסון (מכון ויצמן), ומבנה ה-DNA (רוזלינד פרנקלין).
ברור שאני יהודי. ונמשיך לעשות את כל זה. 😉 חלק 1 בפרופיל.
